name: Modify Asset
description: Modify and delete existing asset members and their properties in SAP Analytics Cloud Planning

getLastEvent.description: Returns the last event generated by the Modify Asset widget.

getData.description: Returns the currently loaded asset members and their editable properties as serialized JSON.

setData.description: Loads existing asset members and their properties into the widget.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Serialized JSON array containing existing asset IDs and their properties.

setCellValue.description: Sets a value in an asset row.

getSelectedData.description: Returns the selected asset rows as serialized JSON.

clearData.description: Clears the current widget data and selection.

onReady.description: Triggered when the widget is ready.

onDataChange.description: Triggered when assets are loaded, selected, edited, cleared, or when an action is requested.
